## Abstract
PRJEB1234 (secondary study accession ERP002070) is an ENA sequencing study titled *“A haplotype map of foxtail millet genome.”* The ENA study record reports 916 sequencing runs, first made public on 2013-06-06. Runs include two organisms: foxtail millet (*Setaria italica*; NCBI Taxonomy ID 4555) and *Setaria viridis*. The returned records are whole-genome sequencing (WGS) libraries from genomic DNA, randomly selected, paired-end, and sequenced on the Illumina Genome Analyzer platform. The examples returned are labelled as worldwide *S. italica* accessions (e.g., Ci003–Ci083) and provide run, experiment, and sample accessions as well as direct FASTQ download URLs. This study provides population-scale genomic read data suitable for haplotype and variation analyses in foxtail millet and includes related *Setaria* material. The current response returned metadata for 28 runs only because the full run listing exceeded the service output-size limit; this subset must not be interpreted as the entire set of 916 runs.

## I. Introduction
**Background.** Foxtail millet, *Setaria italica*, is a grass crop. PRJEB1234 contains WGS data for a haplotype-map study across worldwide accessions.

**Literature Review.** No literature was retrieved for this query.

**Knowledge Gap.** The study-level accession alone does not show its run count, organisms, experimental design, or raw-read availability.

**Objective & Hypothesis.** The objective was to retrieve the contents and scope of PRJEB1234. The expected result was a study record with run-level sequencing metadata.

## II. Materials and Methods
**Study Design.** ENA study metadata were queried because PRJEB1234 is an ENA/BioProject-style study accession.

**Materials.** European Nucleotide Archive (ENA), accessed with `brc_ena_study`.

**Procedures.**  
1. Called `brc_ena_study` with `{"study_accession":"PRJEB1234"}`.

**Statistical Analysis.** The run count of 916 was reported directly by ENA. The number of displayed records, 28, was the service-capped subset of the 916 records. No percentages were calculated.

## III. Results
**Data Presentation.**

**Table 1. Study-level ENA metadata for PRJEB1234.**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Study accession | PRJEB1234 |
| Secondary study accession | ERP002070 |
| Title | A haplotype map of foxtail millet genome |
| First public date | 2013-06-06 |
| Total runs | 916 |
| Organisms represented in runs | *Setaria italica*; *Setaria viridis* |
| Returned run metadata records | 28 |
| Sequencing strategy in returned records | WGS |
| Library source | GENOMIC |
| Library selection | RANDOM |
| Library layout | PAIRED |
| Platform in returned records | ILLUMINA |
| Instrument in returned records | Illumina Genome Analyzer |

**Findings.** ENA reports 916 runs for PRJEB1234. The study includes *S. italica* and *S. viridis*. The returned run subset consists of paired-end genomic WGS libraries generated on an Illumina Genome Analyzer.

Examples of raw-data records include:

| Run | Sample | Organism | Sample title |
|---|---|---|---|
| ERR214766 | SAMEA1905436 | *Setaria italica* | Worldwide foxtail millet accession Ci004 |
| ERR214771 | SAMEA1905359 | *Setaria italica* | Worldwide foxtail millet accession Ci009 |
| ERR214778 | SAMEA1905915 | *Setaria italica* | Worldwide foxtail millet accession Ci016 |
| ERR214765 | SAMEA1905455 | *Setaria italica* | Worldwide foxtail millet accession Ci003 |
| ERR214783 | SAMEA1905853 | *Setaria italica* | Worldwide foxtail millet accession Ci021 |

For example, paired FASTQ files for ERR214766 are available at:

- https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/ERR214/ERR214766/ERR214766_1.fastq.gz  
- https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/ERR214/ERR214766/ERR214766_2.fastq.gz  

## IV. Discussion
**Interpretation.** PRJEB1234 is a population-oriented *Setaria* WGS study designed for haplotype mapping. Its 916 runs provide raw paired-end genomic sequencing data across material including worldwide foxtail millet accessions.

**Context.** The study-level title and run metadata align: returned samples are identified as worldwide *S. italica* accessions, and their sequencing strategy is WGS.

**Limitations.** The ENA response was truncated because returning all run records would exceed the output-size limit. Only 28 of 916 run records were displayed. The project contains more than one organism, so a project-level organism label cannot be assigned to every individual run. No associated publication or study abstract was retrieved.

**Conclusion & Future Directions.** PRJEB1234/ERP002070 contains 916 ENA runs from a foxtail-millet haplotype-map project, with both *S. italica* and *S. viridis* represented. A next query could page through the run list, restricted to Taxonomy ID 4555 for *S. italica*, or retrieve metadata/download links for selected ERR accessions.

## References
[1] European Nucleotide Archive, study file-report API. https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/filereport

## Acknowledgments
European Nucleotide Archive and BRC Analytics.
